# v0.7.0 plan — UDAP Tiered OAuth (client-app side)

Milestone: [v0.7.0](https://github.com/vanessuniq/safire/milestone/3) ·
Issues: #344 (Tiered OAuth request), #345 (release prep) · Depends on: v0.6.0
stack (D-05) · Scope decision: D-15

## Tasks

| # | Concern | Acceptance (spec basis: UDAP STU2 user.md §6.1, discovery.md §2.2) |
|---|---|---|
| 7.1 | Tiered OAuth authorization request | `authorization_url(idp:)` adds `udap` to `scope` and `idp=<IdP base URL>` [N]; `idp` must be an absolute HTTPS URL (OIDC issuer) [I]; readiness: `udap_to` in `udap_profiles_supported` and `"udap"` in `scopes_supported` ("**SHALL** include") else `DiscoveryError` [I] |
| 7.2 | Registration guidance + `invalid_idp` | Docs: clients intending Tiered OAuth "**SHALL** include `udap`" in registration scope [N]; `invalid_idp` error handling (retry with other IdP or without Tiered OAuth, MAY) |
| 7.3 | Demo | IdP field on the UDAP authorization form |
| 7.4 | Release notes + audit + 7.R release-0.7.0 | |

```
release-0.6.0 ── 7.1 feature/udap-tiered-oauth-request ── 7.3 feature/demo-udap-tiered-oauth ── 7.4 docs/v0.7.0-release-notes ── [audit fixes] ── 7.R release-0.7.0
```

Out of scope: data holder ↔ IdP interactions (§6.2–6.3), ID token validation.
